about.Sammaan Capital Limited: Housing and mortgage lender, formerly Indiabulls Housing Finance (renamed in 2024). Makes home loans and loans against property.
about.POWER FINANCE CORPORATION LIMITED: Government-owned financier of India's power sector. Lends to state electricity utilities and power projects.
about.REC LTD: Government-owned financier of India's power sector, formerly Rural Electrification Corporation. A subsidiary of Power Finance Corporation.
about.IIFL HOLDINGS LIMITED: Part of the IIFL group, an Indian financial-services group spanning loans, wealth management and capital markets.
about.NATIONAL HYDROELECTRIC POWER CORPORATION: Government-owned hydropower generator (NHPC), one of India's largest hydro producers.
about.Aditya Birla Capital Limited: Financial-services arm of the Aditya Birla Group: lending, insurance and asset management.
about.Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Autho: Telangana state government's urban-development authority for the Hyderabad region. Check the bond terms for whether the state guarantees it.
